acceptedAnswer.text: Matcha Talk, also called Matcha Malaysia, is a Chinese-first companion platform for adults in Malaysia. Its privacy-first design focuses on voice and video companionship. Explore the platform’s companion styles and service profiles to find an interaction that fits your preferences.

mainEntity.name: What do Matcha PP and companion chat mean?

acceptedAnswer.text: PP refers to a companion, while companion chat describes a way to interact. Matcha is designed for Mandarin voice and video conversations. Each profile explains the interaction style, duration and cha pricing clearly.
Gaming companionship describes shared play and voice interaction. Matcha focuses on online conversation, with profiles identifying the interaction styles they offer.

mainEntity.name: What do privacy-first and E2E encryption mean?

acceptedAnswer.text: Privacy-first means treating personal privacy and boundaries as product design priorities. E2E encryption aims to keep message content readable only at the participating endpoints. Matcha E2E chat is planned; messaging and call protection scopes will be explained separately before launch.

Matcha is designed for adults across Malaysia, including Kuala Lumpur, Penang and Johor Bahru. Chinese is the default language, with an English introduction. Explore service styles, interaction details, duration and cha pricing across the platform.
